name: SUNVIEW
recent: Sunview 正在逐步完成以约 RM30.1 million 出售 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权的交易，并已多次延长 JSNT 收购的完成期限。公司同时完成了最高 10% 的私募配售，并有一项涉及 Labuan 太阳能项目的诉讼。
notable: 以约 RM30.1 million 出售 Winstar Capital 22.44% 股权，并已分阶段完成部分交割。
JSNT 收购的条件先决期限延长至 2027 年 3 月 31 日，完成日期延至 2027 年 5 月 31 日。
最高 10% 的私募配售已完成，最后一批 5,935,910 股于 2026 年 9 月 7 日上市。
risks: 公司就 Labuan 太阳能项目向法院申请追讨欠款。
私募配售最高 10% 新股可能摊薄现有股东持股。
JSNT 收购的完成期限已多次延长。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 RM104.822 million，环比增长 65.7%，同比增长 62.7%；净利为 RM95,000，环比下降 6.9%，同比下降 93.2%，净利率为 0.1%。

recent_en: Sunview is progressively completing the disposal of its 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital for about RM30.1 million, and has extended the completion timeline for the JSNT acquisition multiple times. The company also completed a private placement of up to 10% and has a litigation involving a Labuan solar project.
notable_en: Disposal of a 22.44% stake in Winstar Capital for about RM30.1 million, with partial tranches completed.
Conditions precedent for the JSNT acquisition extended to 31 March 2027, with completion date extended to 31 May 2027.
Private placement of up to 10% completed, with the final tranche of 5,935,910 shares listed on 7 September 2026.
risks_en: The company is seeking court approval to recover sums owed from a Labuan solar project.
The private placement of up to 10% new shares may dilute existing shareholders.
The completion timeline for the JSNT acquisition has been extended multiple times.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was RM104.822 million, up 65.7% QoQ and 62.7% YoY; net income was RM95,000, down 6.9% QoQ and 93.2% YoY, with a net margin of 0.1%.
